wiki.title: Kelly Seyarto
wiki.extract: Dennis Kelly Seyarto (born October 28, 1962) is an American politician serving as the State Senator from the 32nd State Senatorial district. He also served as a member of the California State Assembly from the 67th district from 2020 until his election to the California State Senate in 2022. Seyarto is a former mayor of Murrieta, California.
